The fungi appear to pulse and ripple radially across the surface, giving the impression of deep, subterranean energy currents moving beneath a solid crust.

statement: This sketch depicts a subterranean ecosystem of bioluminescent fungi emerging from a cool-toned concrete matrix. Using synchronized oscillation patterns, the fungal forms pulse and ripple in unison across the canvas, creating an impression of deep earth currents flowing beneath a solid crust. The organic geometries shift rhythmically without external input, conveying perpetual life within the static concrete environment. The glowing structures appear to emanate from within, their light pulsing in harmonious waves that fill the entire scene with a continuous, hypnotic energy.
